principles: One character identity, no duplicate profiles or role-specific workspaces
Enemy is a relationship, not automatically antagonist or evil
Use figuran/background for novels; NPC for games

support_relationship.scope: source character, supported character/group and story context
support_relationship.notes: Optional purpose of support and reason for separation

ui: Edit narrative role, importance and POV in Character Workspace with visible story context
Filter character list by role, importance and POV with a clear reset action
Reuse compatible existing storage, do not create duplicate relationship systems

deferred: Join/leave chapter and timeline links until timeline integration is ready
acceptance: Existing projects open unchanged with unspecified defaults
One character can have different roles in two novels without cross-contamination
A supports B permanently and C temporarily without overwriting either relationship
Duration changes do not change importance or POV
Save/reopen and applicable import/export preserve all fields
Filter/hide and relation removal do not delete character data
Migration/failure tests preserve existing data using temporary projects
UI handles empty/loading/error states, long names, narrow layouts and enlarged text
